description.value:
Your flurry is a combination of actions. You can replace one or both of your attacks during a Flurry of Blows to enter a Stance, or to make Interact actions to Stow, Draw, or to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands}.

If you are an expert in Athletics, you can add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} to your list of actions. If you are an expert in Thievery, you can add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.5eNKs6738aykAhK2]{Dirty Trick} to your list of actions. Using Dirty Trick in this way adds the Attack trait.
